title: Sage Protects Cover with Timber House
whatItIs: A dark green cover with a mint-and-white headline 'You Rest. SAGE Protects!' with the brand mark inline, thin mint circle lines, an avatar node, two logo tiles and a dusk photograph of a timber house with glowing windows.

Warm lit architecture against deep green
Mint highlight on the first line
